scope: Independent direct-ACK delivery-confirmation-unavailable notice and graph-owned observation state

adaptation.authority: Coordinator-directed Android-only presentation; not new Swift parity or whole-WP acceptance
adaptation.freshness: Cold immediate full read then serialized cancellable delay/requery; eventual, not per-commit events or a hard one-second freshness bound
adaptation.ownership: One monitor per active radio graph, shared by lifecycle-collecting routes
adaptation.fencing: Exact radio, session token, observation epoch, request identity and cancellation
adaptation.absence: NoPersistedWildcard is a historical atomic observation only, never delivery/eligibility permission
adaptation.refresh: Inspecting replaces the status with Checking; known wildcard warnings and explicitly historical non-authorizing wording remain stable to avoid repeated announcements
adaptation.failures: Missing capability, mismatched radio, typed store error, interrupted observation and unexpected completion remain explicitly unavailable
adaptation.retention: Same-radio known wildcard warning survives refresh, read failure and close; different-radio evidence is never relabeled
adaptation.actions: Read-only recheck. No send changes, evidence mutation, TTL, reset, delivery settlement or schema change
adaptation.localization: Attributed Android-only input generates separate additive resource files for all 12 supported locales
adaptation.accessibility: Material roles, scalable wrapping text, heading, polite body announcements, native text-button semantics

families: Original typed error and cancellation identity
Wrong-radio snapshot and Inspecting event rejection
Radio/session/process/epoch/recheck request fences and late noncancellable reads
Shared graph subscription, graph replacement and Activity recreation
Screen stop/start while the shared monitor receives new evidence
French copy, forced RTL, 200-percent font, text layout and semantic roles

verification.resource_generation: Executed only in the separate session source artifact; not a test or application build
verification.local_builds_tests_gradle_fetch_decompre: Not run by explicit low-memory direction
verification.hosted_execution: Not run; independent exact-source review and dependency composition required first

integration.reason: Separate fresh-main integration requires the actual storage observer producer and hunk-level held-branch reconciliation
